# Draft:Lottie Mae Howard Howard

Lottie Mae Howard (Née Howard, 7 March, 1887 – 7 May, 1983) Was the Daughter Seventh of Edward Edmond A. Howard and Fannie Elizabeth Gabriel (Née Howard).
She married Henry Durant Howard Jr. On July 1909.
Lottie Mae Howard She was born on 7 March, 1887 at Catawba County, North Carolina, United States. She married Henry Durant Howard Jr. On July 1909 Catawba, North Carolina, United States. She died on 7 May, 1983 Aged 96 at Mooresville, Iredell County, North Carolina, United States.
